Description.span:
This component provides an interface to the SBG inertial and navigation devices, and supports Ellipse Ekinox and Apogee series over serial port interfaces.
It will initialize the COM port, optionally configure the requested output data from the device, and output received measurements in the form of a custom data structure to be decoder with the sbgECom decoder component downstream.
Update in version 2.0.0
Some breaking changes were introduced in version 2.0.0 to upgrade SDK to version 5.4.1684. This introduces changes to the following properties:
  • ship_motion_0_output_mode, ship_motion_1_output_mode etc.: Ship motions are unified into just one field in the new version. Therefore, these properties are replaced with one property ship_motion_output_mode
  • ship_motion_hp_0_output_mode, ship_motion_hp_1_output_mode etc.: Ship motions HP are unified into just one field in the new version. Therefore, these properties are replaced with one property ship_motion_hp_output_mode
Port name to use for establishing communication with the SBG device.
Baudrate to use to communicate with the device on the selected port. It should match the baudrate configured in the device.

If checked, the component will send messages to the SBG device for configuring which messages will be provided by the device and at which framerate, as specfied in the subsequent properties.
Otherwise, the component will just acquire the stream as already configured in the device, no message will be sent to the device itself and the subsequent properties will be ignored.
Output mode for status general, clock, com aiding, solution, heave.
Output mode for UTC time will be emitted by the device.
Output mode for IMU status, acc., gyro, temp delta speeds and delta angles values.
Output mode for magnetic data with associated accelerometer on each axis.
Output mode for magnetometer calibration data (raw buffer).
Output mode for EKF orientation in the form of Euler angles: roll, pitch, yaw and their accuracies on each axis.
Output mode for the EKF orientation data in the form of 4 quaternion values.
Output mode for position and velocities in NED coordinates with the accuracies on each axis.
Output mode for yeave, surge and sway and accelerations on each axis for up to 4 points.
Output mode for GPS velocities from primary or secondary GPS receiver.
Output mode for GPS positions from primary or secondary GPS receiver.
Output mode for GPS true heading from dual antenna system.
Output mode for GPS 1 raw data for post processing.
Output mode for GPS 2 velocity log data.
Output mode for GPS 2 position log data.
Output mode for GPS 2 true heading log data.
Output mode for odometer velocity.
Output mode for event markers sent when events are detected on sync in A pin.
Output mode for event markers sent when events are detected on sync in B pin.
Output mode for event markers sent when events are detected on sync in C pin.
Output mode for event markers sent when events are detected on sync in D pin.
Output mode for event markers sent when events are detected on sync in E pin.
Output mode for doppler velocity log for bottom tracking data.
Output mode for delayed ship motion such as surge, sway, heave at the main monitoring point.
Output mode for pressure sensor such as depth sensor or altimeter.
Output mode for raw USBL position data for subsea navigation.

Messages emitted by the device are published on this output in the form of a custom C data structure.
Definition is as follows and based on data structures defined in sbgECom SDK:

typedef struct SbgEComData
{
SbgEComCmdId cmd;
SbgBinaryLogData logdata;
} SbgEComData;
